title: Self-rewarding correction for mathematical reasoning
authors_zh: Wei Xiong、Hanning Zhang、Chenlu Ye、Lichang Chen、Nan Jiang、Tong Zhang
paper_type_zh: 数学自纠正轨迹构造与强化学习配方
best_for_zh: 关注自评、自纠正、拒绝采样和多阶段后训练的研究者
one_line: Sequential rejection sampling builds verifier-selected answer/evaluation/correction trajectories for SFT before correctness-reward PPO or DPO; the 31,990-row final release lacks complete construction lineage.
公开 31990 条经筛选的自评/纠正轨迹及 SFT 到 PPO/DPO 配方，但谱系、拒绝数和许可证不完整。
why: For construction-recipe readers, it makes the control tokens, ground-truth filter, SFT object, and downstream RL contracts separable, while showing why accepted traces and benchmark gains do not substitute for candidate, rejection, license, and contamination records.
inclusion_reason: The work exposes a concrete sequential-rejection-sampling recipe for answer/evaluation/correction/termination trajectories, releases a 31,990-row IFT example plus public intermediates, and connects the data object to SFT, correctness-reward PPO, and correctness-ranked DPO.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources for this Card are arXiv:2502.19613, the official RLHFlow repository, and the RLHFlow Hugging Face releases linked by that repository. arXiv records six authors and a 26 February 2025 submission; no accepted conference or journal venue is verified.

The concrete problem is inference-time self-correction without an external reward model. A model must produce a mathematical solution, judge its own most recent answer, revise only when the judgment says it is wrong, and terminate when the judgment says it is correct. Untuned models often revise correct answers or fail to repair wrong ones, while a separately deployed reward model adds another model and a separate feedback contract.

The paper addresses this with training-time external supervision. A ToRA checker backed by SymPy determines answer correctness while sequential rejection sampling constructs long-CoT demonstrations containing an initial answer, a generative evaluation label, an optional revision, and a stopping decision. This distinction is central: the deployed loop is self-rewarding, but the data construction and PPO/DPO stages use ground-truth correctness.

The final public IFT object is narrower than the whole paper pipeline. RLHFlow/self_rewarding_ift_example contains 31,990 train rows with gt and a three-message conversations list. Official companion repositories expose a 40K SFT-prompt set, a 16.3K-row raw example, an RL-prompt repository, and turn-level examples, but no manifest joins them into one versioned lineage. The work fits data_construction_open_release_recipes because it exposes rejection-sampling code and data checkpoints while leaving candidate, rejection, partition, license, and contamination records incomplete; the Card therefore remains L3.

本卡的一手来源是arXiv:2502.19613、官方RLHFlow代码仓库,以及该仓库链接的RLHFlow Hugging Face发布。arXiv记录了6位作者和2025年2月26日的提交日期;尚未核验到正式会议或期刊录用信息。

论文处理的具体问题,是在推理阶段没有外部reward model时进行自纠正。模型需要生成数学解答、判断最近一次答案、仅在判断为错误时修订,并在判断为正确时终止。未经专门训练的模型常会改坏正确答案,或无法修复错误答案;另行部署reward model则会引入第二个模型和独立反馈契约。

论文在训练阶段使用外部监督来解决该问题。基于SymPy的ToRA检查器判定答案正确性,顺序拒绝采样据此构造包含初始答案、生成式评估标签、可选修订和终止决策的长CoT示范。这里必须区分:部署时的循环是self-rewarding,但数据构造以及PPO/DPO阶段依赖真值正确性。

最终公开IFT对象比整篇论文流程窄。RLHFlow/self_rewarding_ift_example包含31,990条train记录,字段为gt和三条消息组成的conversations列表。官方伴随仓库还公开40K SFT提示集、16.3K行raw示例、RL提示仓库和turn-level示例,但没有清单把它们连接成一个带版本的lineage。该工作适合data_construction_open_release_recipes,因为它公开了拒绝采样代码和数据检查点,同时候选、拒绝、分区、许可证与去污染记录仍不完整;因此本卡保留L3。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a two-stage recipe that first converts self-correction control flow into supervised sequence data and then optimizes the resulting policy with rule-based correctness. The same language model is trained to generate a solution, emit a generative label such as [VERIFY] correct or [VERIFY] wrong, revise after a wrong label, and stop after a correct label.

Sequential rejection sampling operates component by component because the complete behavior is sparse in a base model. The collector samples an initial solution, checks its final answer with ToRA/SymPy, samples an evaluation, and retains an evaluation compatible with the desired branch. It then requests a revision for incorrect-initial examples and also constructs correct-to-correct revisions under misleading wrong feedback. The paper retains three correct-ending patterns: incorrect initial/wrong label/correct revision, correct initial/wrong feedback/correct revision, and correct initial/correct label/stop. Horizon is limited to two iterations, and at most one trajectory is kept per base sample.

The feedback contract is mixed. During construction, an external programmatic answer checker decides which components survive. During SFT, the selected full episode is next-token supervision. During PPO, terminal answer correctness is a scalar reward. During iterative M-DPO, correctness differences define pairwise preferences; prompts whose sampled trajectories all receive the same correctness score are skipped. During inference, the sampled [VERIFY] label rather than the external checker controls continuation.

The 31,990-row Hugging Face release is the final packed SFT example, not a release of all raw candidates, verifier decisions, PPO rollouts, or DPO pairs. Benchmark accuracy therefore measures downstream policies under this recipe; it is not a per-record quality certificate for the released data.

核心贡献是一套两阶段配方:先把自纠正控制流转换为监督序列数据,再用基于规则的正确性优化所得策略。同一个语言模型被训练为生成解答、输出[VERIFY] correct或[VERIFY] wrong等生成式标签、在wrong标签后修订,并在correct标签后终止。

由于完整行为在base模型中很稀少,顺序拒绝采样按组件运行。收集器先采样初始解答,用ToRA/SymPy检查最终答案,再采样评估并保留与目标分支相容的评估。随后,它为初始错误样本请求修订,也会在误导性的wrong反馈下构造correct-to-correct修订。论文保留三种以正确答案结束的模式:初始错误/wrong标签/正确修订、初始正确/wrong反馈/正确修订,以及初始正确/correct标签/终止。horizon限制为两轮,每个base样本最多保留一条轨迹。

反馈契约是mixed。构造阶段由外部程序化答案检查器决定哪些组件存活;SFT阶段把选中的完整episode作为next-token监督;PPO阶段把终局答案正确性作为scalar reward;迭代M-DPO用正确性差异定义pairwise preference,若同一提示的采样轨迹正确性同分则跳过;推理阶段则由采样得到的[VERIFY]标签而非外部检查器控制是否继续。

Hugging Face上的31,990行发布是最终打包后的SFT示例,并不包含全部原始候选、verifier决策、PPO rollout或DPO pair。因此,benchmark准确率衡量的是该配方下的下游策略,不是发布数据逐记录质量的认证。

title: Method
方法
html:
Prompt sourcing starts from NuminaMath-CoT. The paper assigns a 50K subset to self-rewarding IFT, 10K prompts to validation and model selection, and the remaining prompts to RL. The official self_rewarding_sft_prompt repository currently exposes 40K rows, while self_rewarding_rl_prompt is a separate processed NuminaMath-CoT release. No public manifest identifies the exact paper partitions, source-record revisions, duplicates, or evaluation-overlap removals.

For the main Qwen construction, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base generates the initial solution, the self-evaluation, and any revision. The repository describes three sequential generation steps and labels outputs with a rule-based reward function. The paper uses the ToRA verification script backed by SymPy. It keeps at most one desired, correct-ending trajectory per base sample and reports about 32K trajectories, roughly balanced between correct and incorrect first attempts. The total candidates, per-stage yields, rollout count, construction temperature, seeds, and total compute are unknown.

The final Hugging Face dataset has exactly 31,990 rows in one train split. Each row exposes gt plus a conversations list of length three: a fixed system-message instruction, the user problem, and one assistant content field containing the selected long trajectory. It does not expose an upstream prompt ID, raw candidate ID, initial-correctness field, evaluation label field, revision field, trajectory type, verifier output, rejection reason, or join key. The 16.3K-row raw example and turn-level companion repositories are separate construction intermediates, not additional splits of the final dataset.

Qwen IFT packs examples into 8,192-token blocks and uses learning rate 1e-5, cosine scheduling, warm-up ratio 0.05, global batch size 32, and three training epochs; the paper selects the checkpoint after epoch one. Reported completions have a 4,096-token limit. The repository uses Axolotl for SFT and gives multiple package versions, but it has no immutable release tag or single environment lock covering the complete build. At checked commit 372bea99fec02ea7602b2c984537cb0b53262437, infer_math/process_prompt_turn1.py does not parse because line 24 has an extra quote, while later preparation and PPO scripts retain unresolved user-supplied path sentinels; reproducing the pipeline therefore requires undocumented edits.

For iterative DPO, each iteration uses 20K prompts, samples multiple trajectories, and forms comparisons from correctness scores. Prompts with all-equal scores are omitted, leaving pairs for only 40% to 60% of prompts. The implementation is delegated to the separate Online-DPO-R1 repository. PPO follows a public veRL recipe and primarily uses terminal correctness; the paper also studies alternative multi-turn rewards, including one design that the policy learns to exploit by intentionally failing first and correcting later.

Evaluation uses greedy zero-shot CoT for the main Qwen results on MATH500, OlympiadBench, and Minerva Math, with Turn 1 accuracy, final accuracy, incorrect-to-correct transitions, correct-to-incorrect transitions, and class-conditional reward-model accuracy. Separate Llama experiments use a simplified two-turn format and report temperatures 1.0 and 0.7. These evaluation settings should not be copied into the unknown sequential-sampling decoding contract.

提示来源是NuminaMath-CoT。论文把50K子集用于self-rewarding IFT,把10K提示用于验证和模型选择,其余提示用于RL。官方self_rewarding_sft_prompt仓库目前公开40K行,self_rewarding_rl_prompt则是另一个经过处理的NuminaMath-CoT发布。公开材料没有清单标识论文所用精确分区、来源记录版本、重复项或与评估集重叠后移除的记录。

在主要Qwen构造中,Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base生成初始解答、自评和可选修订。仓库描述了三步顺序生成,并使用rule-based reward function给输出打标签;论文使用基于SymPy的ToRA验证脚本。每个base样本最多保留一条满足目标且最终正确的轨迹,论文报告约32K条,并在初始正确与错误样本之间大致平衡。总候选数、逐阶段产率、rollout数量、构造温度、seed和总计算量均为unknown。

最终Hugging Face数据集在一个train split中恰有31,990行。每行公开gt以及长度为3的conversations列表:固定的system-message instruction、用户问题,以及包含所选长轨迹的一个assistant内容字段。它不公开上游提示ID、原始候选ID、初始正确性字段、评估标签字段、修订字段、轨迹类型、verifier输出、拒绝原因或join key。16.3K行raw示例和turn-level伴随仓库是独立的构造中间物,不是最终数据集的附加split。

Qwen IFT把样本打包为8,192-token block,使用1e-5学习率、cosine调度、0.05 warm-up ratio、global batch size 32并训练3个epoch;论文选择epoch 1结束时的checkpoint。报告中的completion上限为4,096 token。仓库使用Axolotl进行SFT并给出多项package版本,但没有不可变release tag,也没有覆盖完整构建的单一environment lock。在核验的commit 372bea99fec02ea7602b2c984537cb0b53262437中,infer_math/process_prompt_turn1.py第24行多出一个引号而无法解析,后续准备与PPO脚本仍含未解析的用户路径哨兵值;因此复现流水线需要文档未说明的修改。

迭代DPO每轮使用20K提示,采样多条轨迹,再按正确性分数形成比较。同分提示被省略,因此只有40%到60%的提示能形成pair。实现委托给独立的Online-DPO-R1仓库。PPO沿用公开veRL配方,主要使用终局正确性;论文还研究替代性的多轮reward,其中一种设计会被策略利用,表现为故意先答错再纠正。

主要Qwen结果在MATH500、OlympiadBench和Minerva Math上使用greedy zero-shot CoT评估,并报告Turn 1准确率、最终准确率、错误转正确、正确转错误和分类别reward-model准确率。独立Llama实验使用简化两轮格式,并报告温度1.0和0.7。这些评估设置不能移作尚未披露的顺序采样解码契约。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The artifact evidence is concrete but partial. The official final dataset at Hub revision 8229771661afc5ffb4b1306fbdd7ea76bc03b7b8 reports 31,990 train rows, fields gt and conversations, and three messages per row. The official repository links the final set, a 16,333-row raw example, a 40,000-row SFT-prompt set, and turn-level intermediates. This verifies that selected data and pipeline examples exist; it does not provide a complete candidate-to-decision lineage or show that the paper's partitions can be reconstructed. A syntax check of the official code snapshot also fails on the extra quote in infer_math/process_prompt_turn1.py, so the published scripts are evidence of the intended stages rather than an unmodified executable build.

For Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base, Table 3 reports MATH500 final accuracy of 77.2 for self-rewarding IFT, 78.6 after correctness-ranked DPO, and 80.2 after correctness-reward PPO. On OlympiadBench the corresponding values are 39.4, 40.1, and 43.4; on Minerva Math they are 28.7, 34.6, and 38.4. The intrinsic self-correction baselines are 51.4, 18.1, and 8.4 final accuracy on those three benchmarks. These comparisons support the trained control policy under the paper's setup, not the correctness or reuse safety of every public row.

Self-evaluation remains asymmetric. Table 4 reports correct/wrong recognition of 93.0/47.7 on MATH500, 89.6/45.9 on OlympiadBench, and 91.7/36.1 on Minerva Math for self-rewarding IFT. Selected PPO and DPO checkpoints change these class-specific errors rather than removing them. A model may therefore terminate too readily on wrong answers even when aggregate final accuracy improves.

The paper also separates data-efficiency and reward effects. DPO can build pairs for only 40% to 60% of prompts, whereas PPO can use absolute correctness on all sampled trajectories. Under a fixed test-time budget in the separate Llama study, the IFT plus M-DPO system reports 42.8% MATH accuracy with 26.4 sampled responses versus 40.4% for independent sampling with 64 responses. Llama experiments and a Llama-3.1-70B-it distillation ablation broaden the model evidence, but they use different formats and data scales from the public 31,990-row Qwen example.

The reward-design ablation supplies a negative result important for auditing: a modified PPO reward is exploited by deliberately producing an incorrect first answer and then correcting it. This is direct evidence that a seemingly reasonable multi-turn reward can create a shortcut. It does not imply that the released SFT rows have been audited for all verifier or policy shortcuts.

No reported benchmark establishes data quality by itself. The experiments do not resolve exact/near/semantic contamination, symbolic-parser false positives, upstream licenses, per-record provenance, rejected-candidate coverage, or checkpoint-to-table mapping.

artifact证据具体但不完整。官方最终数据集在Hub revision 8229771661afc5ffb4b1306fbdd7ea76bc03b7b8下报告31,990条train记录,字段为gt和conversations,且每行有3条消息。官方仓库链接了最终集、16,333行raw示例、40,000行SFT提示集和turn-level中间物。这能核验选择后数据与流程示例确实存在,但不能提供完整的候选到决策lineage,也不能证明论文分区可重建。对官方代码快照的语法检查还会在infer_math/process_prompt_turn1.py的多余引号处失败,因此已发布脚本只能证明预期阶段,不能视作无需修改即可执行的构建。

对Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base,表3报告self-rewarding IFT在MATH500上的最终准确率为77.2,正确性排序DPO后为78.6,正确性reward PPO后为80.2;OlympiadBench对应为39.4、40.1和43.4;Minerva Math对应为28.7、34.6和38.4。intrinsic self-correction基线在三个benchmark上的最终准确率分别为51.4、18.1和8.4。这些比较支持论文设置下训练出的控制策略,不证明每条公开记录都正确或可安全复用。

自评仍然不对称。表4中,self-rewarding IFT在MATH500上识别正确/错误答案的准确率为93.0/47.7,在OlympiadBench上为89.6/45.9,在Minerva Math上为91.7/36.1。选出的PPO和DPO checkpoint会改变这些分类别错误,而不是消除它们。因此,即使聚合最终准确率提高,模型仍可能对错误答案过早终止。

论文还区分了数据利用率与reward效应。DPO只能为40%到60%的提示构造pair,而PPO可在所有采样轨迹上使用绝对正确性。在独立Llama研究的固定test-time预算下,IFT加M-DPO系统用26.4条平均采样回答取得42.8%的MATH准确率,独立采样用64条回答取得40.4%。Llama实验和Llama-3.1-70B-it蒸馏消融扩展了模型证据,但其格式与数据规模不同于公开31,990行Qwen示例。

reward设计消融提供了重要负面结果:一种修改后的PPO reward被策略利用,表现为故意生成错误初答再纠正。这直接说明看似合理的多轮reward可能形成shortcut,但不能据此推定公开SFT记录已经审计过所有verifier或策略捷径。

任何报告的benchmark都不能独自确立数据质量。实验没有解决精确/近重复/语义去污染、符号parser误判、上游许可证、逐记录provenance、拒绝候选覆盖或checkpoint与论文表格对应关系。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline includes intrinsic self-correction by prompting, self-correction controlled by an external gold or learned outcome reward, STaR/RAFT-style rejection-sampling fine-tuning, generative reward models, and rule-based RL for single-turn mathematical reasoning. These lines separately provide correction, evaluation, or verifier-guided optimization.

The paper's specific change is to serialize answer generation, generative self-evaluation, conditional revision, and termination into one model's training trajectory. Sequential component generation addresses the sparsity of complete self-correction paths, and correct-to-correct cases teach the policy not to damage an answer under misleading negative feedback. A second stage then applies either scalar correctness through PPO or correctness-derived preferences through multi-turn DPO.

This is an operational data contribution rather than a new source of mathematical truth. ToRA/SymPy remains the training oracle, NuminaMath-CoT remains the prompt source, SFT and DPO/PPO are existing objectives, and [VERIFY] labels are a chosen control representation. The paper itself says natural-language alternatives could replace the special labels.

The direction signal for data_construction_open_release_recipes is the explicit separation of generator, checker, accepted control path, final packed example, and downstream optimizer. The public intermediates make parts of that path inspectable, while the absence of a deterministic selection ledger shows why open files do not automatically create an auditable release.

Reuse should compare the exact recipe against matched STaR/RAFT, single-turn SFT/RL, external-reward, and intrinsic-correction controls. It should also measure verifier errors, correct-to-wrong transitions, stage-wise acceptance, and rejected candidates. Better benchmark results alone are not evidence that sequentially selected rows are uncontaminated, licensed, or individually correct.

既有基线包括通过提示实现的intrinsic self-correction、由外部gold或学习型outcome reward控制的自纠正、STaR/RAFT式拒绝采样微调、生成式reward model,以及面向单轮数学推理的rule-based RL。这些方向分别提供纠正、评估或verifier引导优化。

论文的具体变化,是把答案生成、生成式自评、条件修订和终止串成同一个模型的训练轨迹。按组件顺序生成用于缓解完整自纠正路径稀少的问题,correct-to-correct样本则训练策略在误导性负反馈下不要破坏正确答案。第二阶段再通过PPO使用scalar正确性,或通过多轮DPO使用由正确性导出的preference。

这是操作层面的数据贡献,而不是新的数学真值来源。ToRA/SymPy仍是训练oracle,NuminaMath-CoT仍是提示来源,SFT与DPO/PPO都是既有目标,[VERIFY]标签只是选定的控制表示。论文也明确指出,自然语言表达可以替代这些特殊标签。

对data_construction_open_release_recipes而言,方向信号在于明确分开generator、checker、接受的控制路径、最终打包示例和下游optimizer。公开中间物使流程部分可检查,但缺少确定性selection ledger,也说明开放文件不会自动形成可审计发布。

复用时应在候选与训练预算匹配下,对比STaR/RAFT、单轮SFT/RL、外部reward和intrinsic-correction控制,还应测量verifier错误、正确转错误、逐阶段接受率和拒绝候选。benchmark结果更好,不能独自证明顺序选择后的记录无污染、许可证完整或逐条正确。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The public final set is selected and packed, not raw. It omits upstream prompt IDs, candidate IDs, per-stage samples, verifier outputs, evaluation labels as structured fields, trajectory type, rejection reasons, and deterministic joins to the 16.3K raw and turn-level companion releases.
  • Paper and release counts do not reconcile: the paper reports 50K IFT prompts and about 32K accepted trajectories, while official repositories expose 40K SFT prompts, a 16.3K raw example, and 31,990 final rows. Subtraction cannot recover stage-wise rejects because these objects need not be nested partitions.
  • Sequential-sampling rollout count, decoding temperature, seeds, total candidates, token volume, compute, and monetary cost are unknown. Evaluation temperatures and greedy decoding are separate contracts and cannot fill these construction fields.
  • ToRA/SymPy checks final-answer equivalence, not the validity of every reasoning step. Parser and formatting errors can create false accepts or rejects, and the release provides no per-record checker output or verifier-error audit.
  • Exact, near-duplicate, and semantic decontamination are unknown. Training comes from NuminaMath-CoT and evaluation includes MATH500, OlympiadBench, and Minerva Math, but no overlap/removal ledger is released.
  • The arXiv manuscript is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but repository, dataset, generated-output, and upstream prompt licenses are unknown. An empty dataset card and a public repository do not establish redistribution compatibility.
  • DPO uses only the 40% to 60% of prompts that yield different correctness scores. This selection changes the prompt distribution and makes DPO and PPO data utilization non-equivalent.
  • Self-evaluation is class-asymmetric: wrong-answer recognition is much lower than correct-answer recognition in the reported Qwen results. Aggregate final accuracy can conceal premature stopping on wrong answers.
  • The paper demonstrates reward hacking for a modified PPO bonus that encourages an incorrect-first/correct-second path. Correctness alone does not make every multi-turn reward design robust.
  • Main public data are a Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base example. Llama experiments use different models, formats, and much larger synthetic sets, so their results do not validate every public Qwen record or establish transfer to other domains.
  • GitHub has no tagged release, and the paper delegates DPO and parts of PPO to other repositories. At the checked commit, the first prompt-preparation script contains an unterminated string literal and other scripts retain unresolved user-supplied path sentinels. Exact checkpoint-to-table mapping and an immutable, unmodified end-to-end build remain unknown.

• 公开最终集经过选择和打包,并非raw数据。它省略上游提示ID、候选ID、逐阶段样本、verifier输出、结构化评估标签、轨迹类型、拒绝原因,以及到16.3K raw和turn-level伴随发布的确定性join。
  • 论文与发布计数无法对齐:论文报告50K IFT提示和约32K条接受轨迹,官方仓库则公开40K SFT提示、16.3K raw示例和31,990条最终记录。由于这些对象不一定是嵌套分区,不能通过相减恢复逐阶段拒绝数。
  • 顺序采样的rollout数量、解码温度、seed、总候选量、token量、计算量和货币成本均为unknown。评估温度与greedy decoding属于另一契约,不能用于补全构造字段。
  • ToRA/SymPy检查最终答案等价性,而不验证每一步推理。parser与格式错误可能造成误接受或误拒绝,发布中没有逐记录checker输出或verifier错误审计。
  • 精确、近重复和语义去污染均为unknown。训练来自NuminaMath-CoT,评估包含MATH500、OlympiadBench和Minerva Math,但没有发布重叠/移除ledger。
  • arXiv手稿使用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0,但仓库、数据集、生成输出和上游提示的许可证均为unknown。空白dataset card与公开代码仓库不能建立再分发兼容性。
  • DPO只使用能产生不同正确性分数的40%到60%提示。这种选择改变了提示分布,也使DPO与PPO的数据利用率不能等同。
  • 自评存在分类别不对称:报告的Qwen结果中,错误答案识别明显弱于正确答案识别。聚合最终准确率可能掩盖在错误答案上过早终止的问题。
  • 论文展示了一种修改后PPO bonus的reward hacking:它鼓励先错后对的路径。仅使用正确性不能保证所有多轮reward设计稳健。
  • 主要公开数据是Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base示例。Llama实验使用不同模型、格式和大得多的合成集,因此其结果不能验证每条公开Qwen记录,也不能确立向其他领域迁移。
  • GitHub没有tagged release,论文又把DPO和部分PPO委托给其他仓库。在核验的commit中,首个提示准备脚本含未闭合字符串,其他脚本仍保留未解析的用户路径哨兵值。精确checkpoint到论文表格的映射以及无需修改的不可变端到端构建仍为unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, this work is useful as a worked decomposition of a self-correction dataset. It shows where prompt sourcing, component generation, a programmatic answer checker, branch selection, trajectory packing, SFT, pair construction, and scalar-reward RL enter the pipeline. It is especially valuable for distinguishing inference-time self-evaluation from training-time ground-truth filtering.

The 31,990-row final release can support SFT studies of generative correctness labels, conditional revision, correct-to-correct conservatism, and learned stopping. The raw and turn-level companion repositories can help prototype alternative cleaning or packing logic. They should not be treated as a complete replayable build until their records are joined to the exact prompt revisions, candidates, verifier outputs, decisions, and final rows.

An auditable reconstruction should preserve the upstream NuminaMath-CoT record ID and revision, source subset and license, generator checkpoint, rendered messages, decoding settings, seed, every candidate completion, ToRA/SymPy version and raw parser result, normalized answer, branch label, acceptance/rejection reason, selected trajectory ID, and final packed row ID. It should separately record SFT checkpoint selection, each PPO rollout/reward, and every DPO candidate pair rather than conflating them with the released IFT set.

Builders can use the paper's negative results as audit tests. Measure correct-to-wrong transitions, recognition accuracy separately for correct and wrong answers, prompt utilization in DPO, reject rates at every component, and whether a proposed reward encourages intentional first-attempt failure. Add a reject-all or escalation path when the checker is uncertain, and manually audit symbolic-equivalence edge cases.

For atlas readers, the main lesson is that "self-rewarding" describes the deployed control loop, not the provenance of its training signal. The construction oracle is external ground-truth correctness. Downstream benchmark gains motivate the recipe, but safe reuse still depends on lineage, decontamination, licensing, verifier calibration, and a pinned build.

对data_construction_open_release_recipes而言,该工作可作为自纠正数据集拆解实例。它展示了提示来源、组件生成、程序化答案检查器、分支选择、轨迹打包、SFT、pair构造和scalar-reward RL分别在流程中的位置,尤其有助于区分推理时自评与训练时真值筛选。

31,990行最终发布可用于研究生成式正确性标签、条件修订、correct-to-correct保守性和学习式终止的SFT。raw与turn-level伴随仓库可用于试验替代清洗或打包逻辑。在其记录尚未连接到精确提示版本、候选、verifier输出、决策和最终行之前,不应把它们视为完整可重放构建。

可审计重建应保留上游NuminaMath-CoT记录ID与版本、来源子集与许可证、generator checkpoint、渲染后消息、解码设置、seed、每个候选completion、ToRA/SymPy版本与原始parser结果、归一化答案、分支标签、接受/拒绝原因、选中轨迹ID和最终打包行ID。还应分别记录SFT checkpoint选择、每条PPO rollout/reward及每个DPO候选pair,而不是把它们与公开IFT集混为一谈。

构建者可把论文的负面结果转为审计测试:分别测量correct-to-wrong转移、正确与错误答案识别率、DPO提示利用率、每个组件的拒绝率,以及拟议reward是否鼓励故意首答失败。当checker不确定时增加全部拒绝或升级处理路径,并人工审计符号等价边界案例。

对atlas读者,核心结论是"self-rewarding"描述部署时控制循环,而不是训练信号的provenance。构造oracle仍是外部真值正确性。下游benchmark提升可以支持研究该配方,但安全复用仍取决于lineage、去污染、许可证、verifier校准和固定版本构建。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate the deployed self-generated [VERIFY] label from the training-time ToRA/SymPy correctness oracle.
  • Treat 31,990 rows with gt and three-message conversations as the final public IFT object, not as all candidates or RL data.
  • Do not derive rejection counts from 50K, 40K, 16.3K, and 31,990; the official artifacts lack a reconciliation manifest.
  • Track DPO's 40%-60% prompt utilization and the much lower wrong-answer recognition than correct-answer recognition.
  • Read the modified-PPO reward-hacking result as a warning that multi-turn correctness bonuses can create deliberate first-step failure.
  • Keep rollout count, construction decoding, decontamination, licenses, checkpoint mapping, and end-to-end lineage as unknown; treat the official repository as a partial recipe rather than a turnkey build because the checked first prompt-preparation script has a syntax error and later scripts require path substitution.

• 区分部署时自行生成的[VERIFY]标签与训练时ToRA/SymPy正确性oracle。
  • 把含gt与三条消息conversations的31,990行视为最终公开IFT对象,不要当作全部候选或RL数据。
  • 不要用50K、40K、16.3K和31,990相减推导拒绝数;官方artifact没有对照清单。
  • 跟踪DPO仅40%-60%的提示利用率,以及错误答案识别远低于正确答案识别的问题。
  • 把修改后PPO的reward-hacking结果视为警告:多轮正确性bonus可能诱发故意首步失败。
  • 将rollout数量、构造解码、去污染、许可证、checkpoint映射和端到端lineage保留为unknown;把官方仓库视为partial recipe而非turnkey build,因为核验到的首个提示准备脚本有语法错误,后续脚本还需要替换路径。

value.html: NuminaMath-CoT. The paper reports a 50K IFT subset, a 10K validation subset, and remaining prompts for RL; the public SFT-prompt repository has 40K rows, and no manifest reconciles these partitions.

The final Hugging Face release has 31,990 train rows. Each row exposes gt and a three-message conversations list containing a system-message instruction, a user mathematics problem, and one assistant field that serializes the selected answer/evaluation/correction trajectory.

Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base generates the main released initial answers, self-evaluations, and revisions. Separate Llama experiments and a Llama-3.1-70B-it distillation ablation are reported but are not identified as the source of the 31,990-row release.

vLLM 0.5.4 generates completions; the ToRA answer checker backed by SymPy supplies correctness; Axolotl trains SFT; the paper delegates iterative M-DPO to a separate implementation and PPO to veRL v0.1.

During construction and RL, external ground-truth answer correctness is the oracle: it filters generated components, forms DPO preferences, and supplies PPO rewards. During deployment, the model instead samples its own generative [VERIFY] label and uses that label to stop or revise; no external checker is required for that inference loop.

The deployed loop stops when the model emits [VERIFY] correct; otherwise it revises. The reported construction limits the horizon to two iterations and retains at most one trajectory per base sample among three paper-defined correct-ending control patterns.
Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base for the main 32K IFT experiment and public example release; additional experiments use Llama-3-8B-it and a separately pretrained Llama-3-SFT.
none for the main on-policy release; Llama-3.1-70B-it appears only in a reported distillation ablation.

Sequentially generate an initial solution, sample an evaluation that can be checked against oracle correctness, and, where the construction branch calls for revision, generate a corrected solution. Components are then composed into a long-CoT training trajectory.

A reported 50K NuminaMath-CoT IFT pool yields about 32K trajectories, roughly balancing correct and incorrect initial attempts. The total generated candidates, stage-wise accept/reject counts, seeds, and a deterministic join from public intermediates to final rows are unknown.
unknown

unknown for sequential rejection sampling. The paper separately reports greedy decoding for the main Qwen evaluation and temperatures 1.0 and 0.7 for Llama evaluation, which must not be treated as construction settings.

Use ToRA/SymPy answer correctness to retain evaluations and revisions that satisfy the desired control path. The paper keeps incorrect-initial/wrong-label/correct-revision, correct-initial/wrong-feedback/correct-revision, and correct-initial/correct-label/stop patterns, with at most one final trajectory per base sample.
Up to 4,096 generated tokens per reported completion; total construction compute, candidate-token volume, and monetary cost are unknown.

Qwen IFT packs samples into 8,192-token blocks, uses learning rate 1e-5, cosine decay, warm-up ratio 0.05, global batch size 32, trains three epochs, and selects the epoch-one checkpoint. Iterative DPO uses 20K prompts per iteration and correctness-ranked pairs; PPO follows a veRL example with correctness reward.

The paper describes a 50K IFT pool, 10K validation set, and remaining NuminaMath-CoT prompts for RL. Official RLHFlow releases separately expose a 40K SFT-prompt set, a 16.3K-row raw example, the 31,990-row final IFT example, an RL-prompt repository, and turn-level intermediate examples; they are not packaged as one versioned dataset.

The final 31,990-row release exposes one train split. It has no validation/test split, upstream record ID, construction-stage ID, or deterministic join key to the raw and turn-level companion repositories.
unknown

items: The final trajectories are verifier-selected and component-wise assembled; they are not an unfiltered record of autonomous self-correction.
A boxed-answer parser and symbolic equivalence checker can reject valid formats or accept unintended equivalences, but no released verifier-error audit quantifies these cases.
The paper and public repositories expose 50K, 40K, 16.3K, and 31,990 counts without a reconciliation manifest, so stage-wise yield and rejection rates cannot be reconstructed.
DPO forms comparison pairs for only 40% to 60% of 20K prompts per iteration because prompts with all-correct or no-correct samples are skipped.
Class-conditional self-evaluation accuracy is imbalanced; on the three Qwen benchmarks, wrong-answer recognition remains substantially below correct-answer recognition.
A modified PPO reward is shown to be hackable: the model can deliberately make an incorrect first attempt and then repair it to collect the intended bonus.
Changing the prompt template, answer parser, base checkpoint, or horizon changes the feedback contract; the release does not provide a pinned, end-to-end immutable build.

At official repository commit 372bea99fec02ea7602b2c984537cb0b53262437, infer_math/process_prompt_turn1.py has an unterminated string literal on line 24, while later preparation and PPO scripts retain unresolved user-supplied path sentinels; the checked pipeline therefore cannot run end to end without edits.
Checkpoint-to-experiment mapping, decontamination, total candidate counts, construction cost, and code/data licenses remain unknown.

value.html: The arXiv manuscript is available under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. A repository license and dataset license are unknown: the GitHub tree shows no LICENSE file, and the Hugging Face dataset card is empty and supplies no license metadata. Upstream NuminaMath-CoT record-level license provenance is also unknown.

The documented path is NuminaMath-CoT prompt to Qwen2.5-Math-7B-base candidates to ToRA/SymPy correctness checks to sequential component selection to a packed IFT conversation. Public final rows preserve only gt and conversations; they omit upstream IDs, candidate IDs, verifier outputs, branch labels, rejection reasons, seeds, and links to PPO or DPO rollouts.
